mechanism: Modafinil may increase CNS stimulation and potentially antagonize the therapeutic effects of deutetrabenazine (a vesicular monoamine transporter inhibitor used for chorea), while both agents can affect dopaminergic and noradrenergic systems.
action: Monitor for reduced efficacy of deutetrabenazine and increased CNS stimulation; consider alternative wakefulness-promoting agents if possible, or use with careful clinical monitoring.
